universalRules.rawMessage: In multi-icon solutions across all HPE products, OCA CLIC validation attributes child container/chassis service and configuration errors to Item 0100/01 (the first line in the solution tree, Rule 81039677) regardless of where the error actually resides. Never assume the first line is the root cause; inspect child icon containers directly.
universalRules.ruleUpdate: When Rule 81039677 occurs on multi-icon tenders, trace errors to individual child icon containers instead of modifying the root BOM item.
universalRules.scopeEvidence: Vendor-wide across all HPE multi-tier configurations (ProLiant + Synergy + Alletra + Cray).

universalRules.rawMessage: Across all HPE configurations mixing rack servers (DL380) with modular chassis (Synergy frames) or storage (Alletra), NEVER check 'Apply to all icons inside solution' for support or deployment services. Support tiers must be established independently per icon to prevent chassis-level support options from corrupting server containers.
universalRules.ruleUpdate: Configure support services independently per icon container. Never broadcast support attributes across diverse product families.
universalRules.scopeEvidence: Vendor-wide across all HPE multi-tier solutions.

universalRules.rawMessage: When WebLogic OCA gets stuck in contradictory or persistent service rule errors after modifying service lines, the backend pricing/rule engine has a stale session cache. Setting Support to 'No Support' / 'No Installation' and clicking Check flushes the corrupted backend rule cache, allowing clean re-application of the desired support tier with auto-balanced quantities.
universalRules.ruleUpdate: Flush corrupted OCA support session state by toggling to 'No Support' before reapplying 3Y Tech Care Basic.
universalRules.scopeEvidence: Vendor-wide across all HPE OCA configuration sessions.

chassisSpecificRules.rawMessage: Synergy 12000 multi-frame startup services follow the strict formula: 1x HA124A1#5ZM (First Frame Onsite Startup) + (N-1)x HA124A1#5ZQ (Additional Frame Onsite Startup). For 3 frames: 1x #5ZM + 2x #5ZQ. Never order #5ZM with Remote Startup (#V0F) or duplicate #5ZM across frames.
chassisSpecificRules.ruleUpdate: Onsite Frame Startup requires exactly 1x HA124A1#5ZM + (TotalFrames - 1)x HA124A1#5ZQ. Purge all HA124A1#V0F lines when onsite startup is selected.

chassisSpecificRules.rawMessage: HPE One Config Advanced CLIC validation enforces strict 1:1 hardware support entitlement for Virtual Connect 100Gb F32 modules (Rule 99916598/99916599). Every physical 867796-B21 module requires exactly 1 unit of HU4B2A3#Z1R support.
chassisSpecificRules.ruleUpdate: Qty of HU4B2A3#Z1R must exactly equal qty of 867796-B21 (VC SE 100Gb F32 Module).

chassisSpecificRules.rawMessage: HPE Synergy Composer2 appliances (872957-B21) require exact 1:1 matching hardware support entitlement with HU4B2A3#Z1Q (Rule 99916598). 6 physical Composer2 appliances require exactly 6 units of #Z1Q.
chassisSpecificRules.ruleUpdate: Qty of HU4B2A3#Z1Q must exactly equal qty of 872957-B21 (Synergy Composer2 Management Appliance).

chassisSpecificRules.rawMessage: HPE Synergy Brocade 64Gb FC Switch Modules (P77653-B21) require exact 1:1 hardware support entitlement with HU4B2A30BU5. 6 physical Brocade switch modules mandate exactly 6 units of HU4B2A30BU5.
chassisSpecificRules.ruleUpdate: Qty of HU4B2A30BU5 must exactly equal qty of P77653-B21 (Brocade 64Gb FC Switch Module).

chassisSpecificRules.rawMessage: HPE Synergy 480 Gen12 Compute Modules (P68217-B21) require exact 1:1 hardware support entitlement with HU4B2A30BT7. 36 compute modules require exactly 36 units of HU4B2A30BT7 ($3,330 list per unit).
chassisSpecificRules.ruleUpdate: Qty of HU4B2A30BT7 must exactly equal qty of P68217-B21 (HPE SY480 Gen12 Compute Module).

HPE Synergy quoting requires strict decoupling of two independent service domains: (1) HU4B2A3 — ongoing Point-of-Sale hardware maintenance (3Y Tech Care Basic, 9x5 NBD), decomposed per-subsystem (#WJN Frame, #Z1Q Composer2, #Z1R VC, 0BT7 Compute, 0BU5 Brocade); and (2) HA124A1 — one-time professional deployment/startup services (SOW-scoped). These are NOT interchangeable and must never be conflated in BOQ assembly.
chassisSpecificRules.rawMessage: Learning 1 from Synergy BOQ reconciliation: Decoupling POS warranty (HU4B2A3) from professional startup services (HA124A1). Failure to separate causes duplicate charges and CLIC validation errors.

chassisSpecificRules.ruleUpdate: Remote startup (HA124A1#V0F) and Onsite startup (HA124A1#5ZM) are mutually exclusive delivery models for Synergy frame deployment. When Onsite is selected, all Remote startup lines MUST be purged to zero. Quoting both simultaneously creates SOW delivery scope conflicts that trigger CLIC Rule 81039677.
chassisSpecificRules.rawMessage: Remote (#V0F) and Onsite (#5ZM) startup cannot coexist on the same Synergy frame cluster. Purge #V0F completely when delivering onsite.

chassisSpecificRules.ruleUpdate: In multi-icon OCA solutions (Icon Separation mode), CLIC Rule 81039677 ("Installation and Startup must be quoted for ALL frames") attaches its error to Item 0100/01 — the first physical line of the entire solution BOM — even when the root cause is in a completely different icon container (e.g. Synergy Icon #2). Engineers must NEVER modify DL380 server lines to fix this error. Instead, trace to the Synergy icon Services → Lifecycle and fix startup placement and quantities there.
chassisSpecificRules.rawMessage: When Rule 81039677 fires against a DL380 line in a hybrid DL380+Synergy solution, the error is cross-icon attributed. Fix in Synergy Icon #2, not in DL380 Icon #1.

chassisSpecificRules.ruleUpdate: When applying support services in OCA multi-icon solutions, NEVER check "Apply displayed install/support to all icons inside the solution". Always scope to "inside the Current Icon" only. This prevents Synergy frame support attributes from leaking into ProLiant rack server trees (or vice versa), which corrupts per-icon support decomposition and generates phantom entitlement mismatches.
chassisSpecificRules.rawMessage: Icon-level isolation guardrail: Never apply support cross-icon. Keep support scope confined to "inside the Current Icon" in OCA multi-icon solutions.

chassisSpecificRules.ruleUpdate: When OCA CLIC Rules 99916598/99916599 persist after correcting support quantities, the stale rules cache must be flushed: (1) Navigate to Icon container level → Services → set Support to "No Support" with TS5 and "Apply to all nodes inside Current Icon" checked → Save; (2) Dismiss advisory warning about minimum service requirement; (3) Re-apply via "Select Your Own" → filter 3 Years → select HU4B2A3 Tech Care Basic; (4) Set Install Level to "No Installation"; (5) Check "Apply displayed Install/Support level to all nodes inside Current Icon" → OK → Save. This forces OCA to regenerate all child support entitlements from scratch.
chassisSpecificRules.rawMessage: OCA support cache flush protocol: Toggle No Support → re-apply Select Your Own → 3Y Tech Care Basic to clear stale CLIC rule violations 99916598/99916599.

chassisSpecificRules.ruleUpdate: Synergy startup services (HA124A1#5ZM First Frame Onsite, HA124A1#5ZQ Additional Frame Onsite) must be placed ONLY at the Icon #2 container level under Services → Deployment Services → Install-Install and Start Up. They must NEVER be placed locally under individual "Synergy 12000 Frame #N" child items. Duplicate placement between icon container and child frames causes CLIC Rule 81039677 to fire against the first line item (typically DL380) in the solution BOM.
chassisSpecificRules.rawMessage: Startup services go at Icon container level only, never inside child frame items. Duplicating at both levels triggers cross-icon CLIC errors.
